subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should WhatsApp add only a deterministic unknown-group leave and owner-notification policy, or also expose a general group-join hook and agent-callable leave action?
rationale: The current listeners are internal cache lifecycle, while public hooks and destructive tool actions create distinct authorization and compatibility contracts that cannot be selected safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow deterministic policy
options.body: Detect account self-adds, enforce the configured group JID allowlist, optionally leave, and send a trusted owner notification.

options.title: Broader hook and tool API
options.body: Define a public group-join event and separately authorized leave action in coordination with cross-channel group pairing.

options.title: Retain deny-only behavior
options.body: Continue dropping unauthorized traffic and document manual membership cleanup through WhatsApp.

recommendation.title: Narrow deterministic policy
recommendation.body: Detect account self-adds, enforce the configured group JID allowlist, optionally leave, and send a trusted owner notification.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history places this person on the relevant group listener lifecycle and central WhatsApp runtime and docs surfaces.
